$comment: GENERATED from the ISO 4217 active currency & funds code list (Table A.1), maintained by SIX Group on behalf of ISO. Current as of 1 January 2026 (178 codes).
description: Bare ISO 4217 alphabetic currency code, e.g. "USD", "EUR", "JPY". Includes the X-prefixed special-purpose codes (precious metals XAU/XAG/XPD/XPT, IMF Special Drawing Rights XDR, the reserved test code XTS, and XXX for "no currency"). Currency names, symbols, and ISO 4217 minor-unit (decimal-place) counts are NOT included -- the code is the join key into the external reference-data ecosystem (Intl/i18n libraries, ISO 4217 minor-unit tables) for that information, the same way subdivision-code omits display names.
title: ISO 4217 currency code
